rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent low-rise cultural mass across all four views, with a clear stepped dominant body and a secondary lifted/entry condition. It is not just a generic box, and the top view confirms the same overall footprint logic rather than a view-dependent artifact, so it passes the multi-view coherence and collision check. The main weakness is that the access edge response is fairly small and semantically modest; the blue frontage is answered by a local notch/undercut rather than a stronger public court or seam, so void_publicness and program-appropriate threshold expression are only moderate. The silhouette is coherent but somewhat code-like in its terracing, so non_stair_silhouette stays mid-level rather than high. For a museum, the mass can plausibly support galleries/public sequence and controlled daylight, but it still wants a clearer carved public void and more explicit section logic to better express the cultural brief.
